request: I sell provisions at Makola market and I want to keep track of my stock. For each item I want to save its name, how many I have, and the level at which I consider it to be running low. When I sell some of an item the quantity should go down, but I must not be able to sell more than I have. When new goods arrive I record a restock and the quantity goes up. The amount sold or restocked must always be more than zero. I want to see all my items, look at one item, and see a list of the items that are at or below their low level so I know what to buy.
summary:
I've built your stock tracker in `app.py`, and all 7 tests pass. It saves everything in a file called `stock.db` in the same folder and creates that file when the app starts.

**Endpoints:**
- **POST /items**: adds an item. You send `{"name": "rice", "quantity": 10, "low_level": 3}`. The name can't be empty, and the quantity and low level can't be negative.
- **GET /items**: shows all your items.
- **GET /items/low-stock**: shows only the items whose quantity is at or below their low level, so you know what to buy.
- **GET /items/{id}**: shows one item. If there's no item with that number, you get a "not found" error.
- **POST /items/{id}/sales**: you send `{"amount": 4}` and the quantity goes down by that much.
  - A sale of zero or less is refused.
  - A sale for more than you have is refused.
  - A sale for an item that doesn't exist is refused.
- **POST /items/{id}/restocks**: you send `{"amount": 7}` and the quantity goes up by that much.
  - A restock of zero or less is refused.
  - A restock for an item that doesn't exist is refused.

When a sale or restock is refused, the quantity stays the same. The tests check every one of the rules above.

Your four open questions from the plan are not built in yet: a dated history of sales and restocks, changing or removing items, whether two items can share a name, and who else can see or change your stock. Tell me if you want any of them.

plan.summary: This plan keeps a simple stock list for your provisions stall at Makola market. For each item you save its name, how many you have, and the level at which you consider it to be running low. You can add items, see all of them, look at one item, record a sale (the quantity goes down) and record a restock (the quantity goes up). There is also a list of items that are at or below their low level, so you know what to buy. Everything you asked for is included, and nothing was left out. A few questions for you, which are not part of this plan unless you say so: Do you want a history of each sale and restock (with dates), or only the current quantity? Do you want to be able to change an item's name or low level, or remove an item you no longer sell? Should two items be allowed to have the same name? Should anyone other than you be able to see or change this information?

data.name: Item
fields: Name of the item (for example, rice or tin tomatoes)
Low level: when the quantity is at or below this number, the item counts as running low

endpoints.does: Adds a new item to your stock list, with its name, how many you have, and its low level.
Shows all your items with their current quantities and low levels.
Shows one item: its name, how many you have, and its low level.
Records a sale of some amount of this item, and lowers its quantity by that amount.
Records new goods arriving for this item, and raises its quantity by that amount.
Shows only the items whose quantity is at or below their low level, so you know what to buy.

rules: Refuse a sale that is for more than the quantity you currently have of that item.
Refuse a sale where the amount sold is zero or less.
Refuse a restock where the amount restocked is zero or less.
Refuse a sale or restock for an item that does not exist.
